title: Software Engineering Intern - Summer 2025
eligibility: Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD program in Computer Science or related STEM field.
qualification: Pursuing CS degree, proficiency in C++, C#, Java, or Python, understanding of data structures and algorithms.
description: Work alongside full-time engineers to write scalable code, test new feature implementations, and contribute to products like Azure, Windows, or Office.

title: Gates Cambridge Scholarship
eligibility: Citizens of any country outside the UK pursuing a full-time postgraduate degree at the University of Cambridge.
salary: Fully Funded (Full tuition fee, stipend of £20,000/year, travel allowances)
qualification: Outstanding academic record, strong leadership capacity, commitment to improving the lives of others.
description: Full-cost scholarships for postgraduate study in any subject offered at the University of Cambridge for international students.

title: Junior Frontend Developer
eligibility: Open to young professionals with at least 1 year of experience building applications with modern web tech.
qualification: Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience, working knowledge of Vue.js or React and modern JavaScript.
description: Contribute to building user interfaces across GitLab's open-core DevOps platform while collaborating asynchronously across global time zones.

title: Associate Product Manager (APM)
eligibility: New graduates or early-career professionals with 0-2 years of full-time work experience.
qualification: BS/MS degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent technical experience.
description: Rotational product management program designed to develop early-career talent through hands-on technical product launches across Google services.

title: Microsoft Imagine Cup 2025
eligibility: Students aged 16+ actively enrolled in high school, college, or university worldwide.
salary: Up to $100,000 USD Grand Prize + Mentorship
qualification: Student teams of 1 to 4 building an original tech project utilizing Microsoft Azure cloud or AI tools.
description: Global technology competition empowering student founders to build impactful startups leveraging artificial intelligence and cloud technologies.

title: CS50: Introduction to Computer Science
eligibility: Open to students and professionals of all backgrounds worldwide with no pre-requisites.
description: An entry-level course teaching algorithmic thinking, problem-solving, and foundational computer science concepts using C, Python, SQL, HTML, CSS, and JS.
